field: song_id of each item (iterate over all pages; show_song is called once per song)

computed: size of the set union of (song_ids from song library whose show_song release_date >= 2022-01-01) and (song_ids of album-library albums whose release_date >= 2022-01-01); threshold = start of last year relative to phone.get_current_date_and_time / 2023-05-18
